comment: Furiah's Visuals: the Inferno Scythe's animation set: both hands on the shaft, the crescent hanging from the head. Swings run in vanilla's swing time; t is 0..1 of each clip. right: the fist in view space (offset in blocks, turns in degrees about the fist: pitch up, yaw left, roll counter-clockwise), or an exact place and direction ({pos, tip, edge}). flare: the blade's heat (0: as hot as at rest, 1: white-hot, -1: cold; the Infernal finish lights from the core outward as it warms). Events: ignite (sparks at the core), flare (a burst of embers off the edge). Every clip here is original to this mod.

inferno_scythe_swing_1.comment: A wide reaping arc from right to left, the crescent swept round low.

inferno_scythe_swing_2.comment: A diagonal cleave from high on the right down to the lower left.

inferno_scythe_swing_3.comment: A reaping arc back from left to right, low, the point leading.

inferno_scythe_quick_swing_1.comment: Rapid clicks: a short reap to the left.

inferno_scythe_quick_swing_2.comment: Rapid clicks: a short cleave down to the left.

inferno_scythe_crit.comment: A critical hit: raised overhead and brought down in a long diagonal cleave, the crescent hooking through.

inferno_scythe_guard.comment: Blocking: the shaft brought across the body, the head up to the left, the blade high behind it.

inferno_scythe_draw.comment: The draw: swung up from below into the hold, cold; the core catches with a burst of sparks and the blade ignites from it outward to the point.

inferno_scythe_hellfire.comment: Hellfire: the scythe brought up in front, the crescent side on; the heat lines flare to white-hot and embers burst off the edge, twice; then it cools back with a flicker.

inferno_scythe_reap_spin.comment: A full spin around you: swept round to the left, behind, and back in from the right, the crescent leading.

inferno_scythe_shoulder_rest.comment: Laid back over the right shoulder, the crescent behind you, rocked a little; then back to the hold.
